steps.title: Fold the strip in half into a rectangle
steps.common_mistake: Keep the edges aligned before creasing.

steps.title: Fold the square in half into a rectangle
steps.common_mistake: Match the edges exactly before creasing.

steps.title: Fold the rectangle corner diagonally into a triangle
steps.check_question: Is the paper shaped as a triangle with three corners?
steps.common_mistake: Align the corner with the opposite edge.

steps.title: Fold the top corner down across the triangle
steps.common_mistake: Keep the flap edges lined up before folding.

steps.title: Fold the wide corners over the center
steps.common_mistake: Fold both corners equally toward the center line.

steps.title: Open the folded shape into a square
steps.check_question: Is the paper a square with four corners and creases meeting at the center?
steps.common_mistake: Unfold gently so creases stay sharp.

steps.title: Fold corners to the center into a rectangle
steps.common_mistake: Meet the corners exactly at the center point.

steps.title: Fold the flaps in to a small packet
steps.common_mistake: Tuck flaps inside evenly on both sides.

steps.title: Tuck the flaps to form a pocket
steps.check_question: Is the paper a puffed pocket with its flaps tucked inside?
steps.common_mistake: Tuck each flap fully inside before pressing.
